# Version 4.150.2
> **Ganesh correctness fixes** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 refreshes the m150 engine with Ganesh and SkSL correctness fixes. The update addresses stale GPU readbacks, failed resolve and flush handling, framebuffer cleanup, and RasterPipeline code generation.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh failure handling is more reliable** — Failed flushes no longer return stale texture readbacks, and failed resolve tasks restore MSAA and mipmap dirty tracking. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561))
- **GPU and shader engine fixes are included** — Updates framebuffer deletion behavior for Imagination GPUs and fixes a use-after-free in SkSL RasterPipeline code generation. ([#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561), [#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

Ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2 alongside the SkiaSharp 4.150.2 servicing release.
